          About & Disclaimer

          About this app

          My Holy Bible is a personal, non-commercial Bible reading app, made for the glory of God and the encouragement of His people. It is free to use and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any publisher, church, or ministry.

          Scripture text

          The main text is the King James Version (KJV), which is in the public domain in the United States. Red letters, footnotes (the KJV translators' original margin notes) and verse divisions follow standard KJV editions.

          The versions shown inside Compare (Geneva 1599, American Standard Version, Young's Literal, Darby, Webster 1833, Tyndale New Testament, World English Bible and the Berean Standard Bible) are in the public domain.

          Scripture quotations marked NLT are taken from the Holy Bible, New Living Translation, copyright © 1996, 2004, 2015 by Tyndale House Foundation. Used by permission of Tyndale House Publishers, Carol Stream, Illinois 60188. All rights reserved.

          Other versions

          All other translations listed under “More versions” are the property of their respective copyright holders. Their text is not stored in or copied into this app; tapping one simply opens that verse on the Bible Gateway website in a new window.

          Study helps

          Word definitions come from Noah Webster's 1828 American Dictionary of the English Language and Easton's Bible Dictionary (1897), both in the public domain. Short notes on old KJV words were written for this app. Cross references are generated within the app by matching related words and phrases across the KJV. They are reading aids, not official or doctrinal references.

          Study helps are offered to assist reading. They are not a substitute for prayerful study of God's Word, the guidance of the Holy Spirit, and sound teaching within the local church.

          Strong's numbers

          Strong's numbers are from the public-domain KJV with Strong's numbers (eBible.org, KJV 2006 edition), matched word by word to this app's text. Hebrew and Greek definitions are from James Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890, public domain), using the Open Scriptures JSON edition (openscriptures/strongs, CC BY-SA).

          Who's speaking

          Speaker labels are a best-effort guide, so please check the surrounding verses for context. Quoted speech comes from the MACULA Quotation and Speaker Data, © 2023 by Clear Bible, Inc (CC BY 4.0, github.com/Clear-Bible/speaker-quotations), which includes Glyssen data © SIL LSDev and Faith Comes By Hearing (MIT). A speaker is shown only when at least two of the dataset's translation alignments agree. Words outside quotes are credited to the book's traditional author, and Psalms use their titles. Authorship of some books is uncertain and is marked “traditional.”

          Character Studies

          The character studies are original summaries written for this app. Name meanings are from Hitchcock's Bible Names Dictionary (public domain). Every reference links to the KJV text, so please read each passage in its context.

          Fonts

          OpenDyslexic by Abbie Gonzalez is included under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Other fonts are from Google Fonts under the SIL Open Font License.

          Bible Dictionary

          Articles are from Easton's Bible Dictionary (M. G. Easton, 1897), and name meanings are from Hitchcock's Bible Names Dictionary (R. D. Hitchcock, 1869). Both are in the public domain. Digital text via the JWBickel/BibleDictionaries and Open Christian Data projects. People / Places labels are added automatically and may occasionally be wrong.

          Your privacy

          Your bookmarks, highlights, notes, journal and folders are saved only on your own device. Nothing is collected, sold or shared. Use Backup to keep a copy safe.

                    Back Up My Saves

                    Saves your bookmarks, highlights, notes, journal and folders. Email it to yourself or keep the file somewhere safe, like your email, Google Drive or Files.

                    Restore

                    Bring back saves from a backup. Nothing you have now gets deleted. Anything missing is added back.

                    Or paste the backup email text here:

                    Sync with Google

                    Keeps your bookmarks, highlights, notes, journal, folders, reading places, Quick Reads and settings safe in your own Google Drive, and the same on every device you sign in on. Nothing is ever deleted when syncing.

                    Your saves stay on this phone too, so the app works offline. Sync uses a private app folder in your Google Drive that only this app can see.
